name: spot
description: Spot connects ChatGPT to authorized insurance workflows for quotes, certificates, policy evidence, compliance, files, and procurement.

interface.longDescription: Find and manage insurance quote requests, compare bound policy evidence with contract requirements, prepare certificates of insurance, and review compliance. Spot enforces the connected account’s role, authorization, and approval boundaries.
defaultPrompt: Create an insurance certificate for this policy.
Compare this requirement with my bound coverage.
